patterns.note: Sections are full-width with dark backgrounds, often featuring a large centered heading, followed by a grid of feature cards or content blocks, frequently accompanied by isometric illustrations.
A deep dark purple/blue is the dominant background, contrasted with bright teal/green for primary calls-to-action and glowing accents within illustrations, creating a futuristic and high-tech feel.

Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, often centered, providing strong visual hierarchy. Body text is clean and highly readable, complemented by smaller uppercase labels for sub-sections or categories.

As the user scrolls, the initial hero content (heading and illustrations) scrolls out of view, while the navigation bar transforms from transparent to an opaque dark background. Subsequent content sections and individual elements within them reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport.
Each major section introduces a distinct concept or feature, clearly delineated by full-width background colors and generous vertical padding, often featuring a unique isometric illustration set.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered animations (likely using AOS as hinted) are employed to reveal content blocks, cards, and illustrations with a staggered fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport. The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay to a solid dark background with a subtle shadow upon scrolling past the initial hero content. The hero background elements exhibit a subtle parallax scroll effect.

Isometric illustrations are extensively used to depict digital products, devices, and abstract concepts, giving a futuristic and tech-savvy feel. These illustrations often incorporate the brand's accent colors as glowing elements to draw attention and add visual interest.

Content is structured into full-width sections with generous vertical padding, creating an airy feel and clear visual separation. Within sections, content is often presented in responsive grids (e.g., 3-column feature cards, 2-column text blocks) to organize information effectively.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~3-4x body text) with a clean, readable body text, complemented by smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card edges, with some elements having sharper corners for a modern tech feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in hero and section padding, creating clear visual separation, while content grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of isometric, glowing illustrations against a dark, cosmic background creates a unique futuristic and secure aesthetic for a crypto wallet. The consistent visual language of these illustrations, combined with the vibrant accent colors, makes the complex topic of crypto feel approachable and visually engaging.
